verdict: Yes. Aseem Shakti pitched a ready-to-wear pocket saree on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Many young women love sarees but find draping hard, and pre-draped sarees solve that in minutes.
angle: Pre-draped sarees appeal to young women, working professionals and diaspora buyers who don't know how to drape. They sell for weddings, office events and festivals. Fit is less of an issue than with other clothing, but stitching quality matters.
